## Decisions

- User selected Acidwave, Y2K Futurism, K-Design, Dreamscape, Halftone, Hyperbloom, Neo-brutalism, Neo-Swiss, Synthwave, and Vector-surrealism.
- Add all ten to Work → UI / UX with real page screenshots, mood filters, and style search.
- Keep original UI concepts distinct from existing shipped products and practical demos.
- Share only accessibility resets and the return/style navigation between specimens.


- Motion Lab Vol.02: ten additional interactive concepts, led by the Sparkform-inspired OUTFORM character page. Shared lifecycle provides pause, reduced motion, offscreen rendering control, GPU cleanup and fallback artwork.

- MINA extends Vol.02 to eleven studies using the user-supplied character recording as the visual direction; six original aligned renders provide responsive gaze and expressions.

- Video-driven additions: MINA gains deformable cheeks; SOFT SPOT, RAIL and ECHO ZERO extend Motion Lab to fourteen studies (24 designs across both collections).

- MINA refinement: pulling a cheek produces an angry expression with a small local stretch, then restores the selected mood on release.

- MINA pointer movement changes gaze without tilting or rotating her head.

- MINA gaze tracks both cursor axes within the eye regions; cheek pulling temporarily overrides the gaze with an angry squint.

- ECHO ZERO quality revision: replace the procedural figure with a properly authored character, posed and prepared in Blender for full rotation.

- TALIA adds a separate anime cybernetic portrait from the user image, bringing Motion Lab to fifteen studies and the UI gallery to 25 designs.

- Services now uses eight service tabs and a wide charcoal masonry gallery, based on the user reference. UI/UX leads with all 25 studies; every other tab shows related Work projects. The main homepage expands to 1520px, with Services spanning nearly the viewport width.

- Services ordering refinement: use a stable left-to-right grid instead of balanced columns. General Services navigation retains the selected category; repeated clicks on the active tab leave its gallery untouched.

- RAIL garment refinement: four original hollow GLB silhouettes replace the flat extruded clothes; improve sleeve construction, collars, hoods, fabric and hardware. Product panels show the real 3D garment with Front / Back controls.

- RAIL second quality revision: the user rejected the inflated garment models. Use original Blender cloth-simulated panels with shaped sleeve support, folded hoods, baked occlusion and dye-cloud prints; soften the floor shadows and keep the rack crossbar straight.

- RAIL interaction refinement: pack garments closer together, bring the hovered piece forward to face the camera, and slide its neighbours aside. Stabilize selection during movement and keep mobile garments clear of their labels.

- RAIL hanger fit: support arms follow the shoulder seams inside the cloth. Shorter hooks and raised garments close the gap at the neckline; hanger and garment move together during hover.

- RAIL fast hover: remove the earlier dwell and transition lock. Select immediately during pointer movement, retarget in-progress turns, and use faster garment and label animation.

- AKAI adds an original illustrated scroll story and interactive botanical soda collection as study 16 (26 designs overall). No MotionSites prompts or third-party site artwork/code were used, as requested by the user.

- LocalNinja katana revision replaces AKAI in place: the user’s hill → eye → red → rival → glance → sword-clash story leads to Wind (green), Water (blue), and Fire (red). Use original generated artwork, accessible product selection, enquiry links, and sequential reduced-motion panels. Keep the existing study URL and 26-design count.

- MINA is hidden from Work, homepage Services, and the Motion Lab picker/Next navigation at the user’s request. The visible collection now contains 15 Motion studies and 25 designs overall.

- Studio themes follow the system until a header toggle stores a preference. Theme selection persists across Studio pages and browser tabs. Dark Hero, Services, About, Footer, Work and contact form are pitch black. Contact uses deep navy blue #0b2447 in both themes with light copy; Custom solutions remains grey in both themes.
- Remove the homepage “Things we've built” teaser. Widen Work to 2240px with small outer gutters, remove the Motion Lab title/intro block, and show screenshot thumbnails on all project cards. Voice Bots retains the actual voice assistant without an extra screenshot.

- ECHO ZERO is also hidden from Work, homepage Services, and shared Motion navigation. The visible collection now contains 14 Motion studies and 24 designs overall; standalone files remain preserved.

- LocalNinja Cities replaces SOFT SPOT’s animals with Ottawa, Toronto and Windsor miniature dioramas at the same URL. Keep the three palettes and carousel, use city details on tap, apply LocalNinja branding, and refresh Work/Services previews.

- TALIA gains an Offline state with a new closed-eye image, sleeping gaze/idle behaviour, explicit wake controls, and a matching project-card image. Preserve her pose and outer silhouette when switching expressions.

- Homepage hero: seven service illustrations on a tilted, curved 3D wheel inspired by the user's Framer reference. Cards rotate with the cylinder, with stationary center copy. Keep the existing blue, dark and light palette; provide pause, keyboard navigation and a reduced-motion grid.

- All homepage service tabs reuse each project’s existing recording and poster from one shared media catalog. Repeated projects retain consistent moving previews; every gallery has independent pause controls and preserves reduced-motion/data-saver defaults.
